baseline_differences.difference: Original uses ConfigUtils.getHostAndPort inside try/catch; 3.6.2 uses NetUtils.getIPV6HostAndPort with last-colon fallback. Original variant retained and explicitly labeled; cannot establish its exact alternate version from export.
Original author changed MAX_SEND_PING_INTERVAL to 10000000 ms for debugging. Release value is 10000 ms. Both values explained; original executable logic retained.
Original omits operation cases and exception handling with ........... . Retained and explicitly marked as incomplete reading excerpt, not compilable method.
RequestThrottler, persistent watch modes, digest log/snapshot fields, and notification delivery all occur in pinned 3.6.2 source. They have not been incorrectly labeled later additions.

items: Use conf/zoo_sample.cfg, not zoo_example.cfg.
Import root Maven reactor and generated Jute sources.
Follow pinned clean install build command and supported JDK instructions.
Include provided metrics-core and snappy-java jars on standalone IDE runtime classpath; upgrades/scope edits were original workarounds, not release requirements.
Use explicit logging config rather than moving checked-in conf resources.
All original five screenshots reconstructed as setup panels; no IDE execution is claimed.
min/max session timeout defaults are 2 and 20 times tickTime when unspecified.
sessionlessCnxnTimeout concerns a connection lacking a session and is reused for expiration buckets.
AcceptThread enqueues accepted channels in acceptedQueue, not updateQueue.
Disabling interests serializes readiness tasks per connection, not every abstract network event.
Parsed chroot retains /tt leading slash.
primeConnection queues the handshake; response processing completes it.
readConnectResult belongs to ClientCnxnSocket.
ZooKeeper constructor starts connection asynchronously.
Time.currentElapsedTime uses elapsed time rather than epoch wall-clock time.
Rounding always advances to next interval, including boundary inputs.
ExpiryQueue creates no management thread; callers consume expiration buckets.
Corrected missing semicolon after request.setAcl(acl) and stray quotation after incomingBuffer.slice(); visible copy-error note.
Aggregate default large-request limit is 100 MiB, not 100k; classification defaults disabled.
Distinguish protocol Request.record from prepared Request.txn.
Prospective ChangeRecords do not publish live node state before final processing.
Preallocation is a 64 MiB increment, not fixed log file size.
txnEntryCRC uses Adler32 in this release.
Durability depends on forceSync and flush configuration; snapshots are not required per acknowledgment.
addWatch provides persistent modes; ordinary one-shot watches use read/existence APIs.
Recursive registrations cover descendants and retain changed path in event; NodeChildrenChanged is excluded.
User watchers and callbacks execute on EventThread.
Reads are not state-changing transactions.
Log-only reconstruction is possible with suitable initial state/full retained history, but snapshot-plus-replay is normal.
Filename suffixes are hexadecimal zxids.
64 MiB is configurable preallocation increment; physical contiguity and seek elimination are not guaranteed.
Snapshots are fuzzy and require covering log replay, not strictly all records less than suffix.
czxid, mzxid, pzxid, child-list cversion, public version/aversion semantics corrected.
Public dataLength/child counts are derived rather than StatPersisted fields.
Session timeout map persisted; ephemeral-owner sets reconstructed from nodes.
Node map keys are full paths.
Original example filenames, digest values, record contents, and snapshot displays labeled illustrative; no new execution results claimed.
